10k.note: Diagnostics company; commercial CyPath Lung flow-cytometry sputum test plus preclinical/discovery-stage therapeutic and companion diagnostic programs.

website.note: No dedicated /pipeline page. Homepage describes commercial CyPath Lung diagnostic only; therapeutic discovery programs not detailed.

ctgov.note: Active sputum-based diagnostic validation study NCT07168993 (Detection of Early-Stage Lung Cancer in Sputum using Flow Cytometry and an Automated Analysis Pipeline) is a diagnostic device clinical validation, not a P1/P2/P3 drug trial.

commercial_product.name: CyPath Lung
commercial_product.modality: In vitro diagnostic / lab-developed test (flow cytometry + AI on sputum)
commercial_product.indication: Noninvasive assessment of patients at high risk for lung cancer with indeterminate pulmonary nodules 6 to <30 mm
commercial_product.status: Commercially available via wholly owned CLIA lab Precision Pathology Laboratory Services (PPLS); Medicare PLA code 0406U effective Jan 1, 2024

ongoing_validation_study.title: Detection of Early-Stage Lung Cancer in Sputum using Flow Cytometry and an Automated Analysis Pipeline (FlowPath Lung)
ongoing_validation_study.sites: Brooke Army Medical Center, Walter Reed, Naval Medical Center San Diego (via DoD MCCRP collaboration)

excluded_preclinical.program: Broad-spectrum cancer therapeutics (siRNA and TCPP-porphyrin conjugates)
excluded_preclinical.stage: Preclinical / discovery; intends to seek strategic partners

excluded_preclinical.program: Companion diagnostics for asthma and COPD biologics (e.g., dupilumab, benralizumab patient selection)
excluded_preclinical.stage: Research collaboration with BAMC; first patient studies expected 2026
excluded_preclinical.reason: Diagnostic discovery, not a drug; not yet in interventional registry trials

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: bioAffinity Technologies is a diagnostics/lab-services company. Its sole commercial product is the CyPath Lung sputum flow-cytometry test (offered via its CLIA lab subsidiary PPLS). Therapeutic candidates are preclinical/discovery-stage (siRNA, TCPP conjugates) and companion-diagnostic programs are in research phase. The single active ctgov study (NCT07168993) is a diagnostic validation study, not a P1/P2/P3 drug trial. No active P1/P2/P3 drug or device pivotal pipeline.
